jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Unsere Mission bei Drevise Die Fertigungsindustrie bildet das Fundament unserer modernen Welt. Doch während künstliche Intelligenz ganze Branchen verändert, arbeiten Ingenieure und Fertigungsexperten noch immer mit fragmentierten Systemen, manuellen Prozessen und Wissen, das über unzählige Dokumente und Unternehmen verteilt ist. Wir bei Drevise wollen das grundlegend verändern. Wir arbeiten an einer Zukunft, in der technisches Wissen nicht länger in einzelnen Systemen und Köpfen verborgen bleibt, sondern intelligent miteinander vernetzt wird. Dafür entwickeln wir eine KI-Plattform, die technische Produktdaten versteht, Experten unterstützt und Unternehmen miteinander verbindet. Unser Ziel: Die Art und Weise neu definieren, wie Produkte weltweit entwickelt, gefertigt und auf den Markt gebracht werden. Unser Team will mehr, als nur einen Job zu machen: Wir hinterfragen bestehende Grenzen, übernehmen Verantwortung und bauen gemeinsam etwas auf, das bleibt. Wer bei Drevise einsteigt, gestaltet nicht nur ein Unternehmen mit, sondern die Zukunft einer der wichtigsten Industrien der Welt. Deine Aufgaben Als Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) begleitest du unsere Kunden vom Onboarding bis in den Arbeitsalltag und sorgst dafür, dass Drevise dort messbaren Mehrwert schafft. Du verantwortest deine Kunden, erkennst Wachstumspotenziale früh und baust unsere Customer-Success-Organisation von Anfang an mit auf. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, verstehst ihre Prozesse und Herausforderungen und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf. Du begleitest neue Kunden beim Onboarding und stellst sicher, dass sie unsere Lösungen erfolgreich einsetzen und echten Mehrwert erzielen. Du beantwortest Kundenanfragen schnell und lösungsorientiert, koordinierst technische Fragestellungen und sorgst für eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit. Du erkennst frühzeitig Herausforderungen, förderst die aktive Nutzung unserer Plattform und identifizierst Potenziale für eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit

jobs.title: Clinical Growth SDR
jobs.description: Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults. Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that. We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life. Prosper is growing 3x year over year and is at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 1,000+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults. About Prosper Health Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults. We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We're growing 3x year over year, at high-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 600+ clinicians - and our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindness, and high performance, integrating perspectives from clinicians and autistic self-advocates. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. jobs.description: About Enode The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale. We’re the layer between the home and the grid. Our platform connects every asset, coordinates every home and shapes thousands as one. Asset connectivity gives energy retailers one API for 1,000+ device models across 100+ brands. Home energy coordination turns that connection into smarter behavior at home, like charging an EV in the cheapest hours or using more of your own solar. Residential flexibility brings connected homes together into a dispatchable resource the grid can count on. Europe’s largest energy companies build on Enode : retailers, utilities and the teams that trade for them. The platform spans 1.7M+ connected households and 5,000+ MW of controllable load. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital and Creandum. The decisions made now will shape how the next grid gets built. We’re looking for people who take ownership, think clearly under complexity and care deeply about the craft of building software that matters. AI is fundamental to how we work AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at. jobs.title: Accounting Manager - Mexico remote
jobs.description: About Proper Proper is an AI-first accounting service built for property managers and real estate operators. We combine automation, our own technology and a global team of accounting experts to run financial operations that are faster and more accurate than what the industry has settled for. We are 480 people across the US, Colombia and Mexico, serving 175 property management and real estate clients. We are a San Francisco based company and most of our accounting organisation is in Latin America. The role You will run a pod: roughly 20 client accounts, 4 to 6 direct reports, and the 20 or so people who sit under them. Your direct reports are Senior Accountants and Principal Accountants, and each of them leads a small team and owns a set of clients. You are accountable for three things. Whether those clients stay. Whether the work reaching them is right. Whether the pod makes money. What makes this job different from most accounting management roles is where you sit. You are not the client's day-to-day contact, and you are not the last person to review every deliverable. Your Senior Accountants do that work and report to you on it. Your job is to know independently whether their picture is accurate, and to coach what you find. That means opening the books yourself, listening to recorded client calls, and forming your own view of an account rather than accepting a status update. If that sounds like less control than you are used to, it is actually more responsibility, and it is the part of the role we care most about. Key Responsibilities Knowing the truth about every account. Run health-check style reviews on client books, looking for discrepancies and for what they say about how the accounting has actually been done. Review our client health dashboard and act on what it surfaces. Spot check financials and client communications. Track error rates. Stay close to escalations and confirm they get resolved. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. Fraud and regulation are rising, costing the UK economy over £100bn every year; this makes it more difficult for businesses to protect themselves and their clients - individuals like you and me - from fraud and money laundering. Our co-founders Olly and Jack were led to this area when a friend was defrauded of £25K when buying their first property. At the time, anti-fraud technology didn’t exist, which meant that completing the anti-fraud checks required in these processes was largely manual. These big life moments should be exciting, but instead are often confusing and scary due to the painful process of completing these paper-based checks and the risk of fraud. Thirdfort helps businesses to facilitate these anti fraud checks so that individuals know they can transact safely and seamlessly with professionals during these big transactions. Our anti-fraud platform provides a secure way for professionals in regulated sectors like Lawyers, Estate Agents and Accountants to transfer funds and verify sensitive information through app based document checks, facial recognition and open banking. Over 1,500 businesses now trust Thirdfort to verify their clients. We are FCA regulated and have raised over \$33m in capital from leading Fintech investors Breega and Element Ventures, as well as the founders of Zoopla, Funding Circle, Comply Advantage, Tessian, Fenergo and Fidel. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems , owning technical direction within a domain, and helping other engineers grow through mentorship and example. At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We test our code in unit tests, simulations, and directly on real robots. Grounding our models in deployment allows us to truly measure performance. High leverage, high impact. We’re still a highly focused team. If your training recipes improve our agents, you directly change the economics of the company. World-class peers. jobs.title: Elektriker (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Chipindustrie – von Anfang an! Deine Rolle bei Black Semiconductor Bei Black Semiconductor entwickeln wir eine neue Generation der Halbleitertechnologie. Mit unserer ersten Produktionsanlage FabOne in Aachen schaffen wir die Grundlage für die Chipfertigung der Zukunft. Dafür suchen wir dich! Als Elektriker*in wirst du Teil unseres Facility-Teams und unterstützt den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme und den Betrieb der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage. Über uns Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen. Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist. Unsere Technology Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz. Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau. Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiter

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Robotics Platform
jobs.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. About the role At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. Enpal macht das mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie möglich – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox und Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+ , die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Mit Enpal.Cool bauen wir eine neue Abteilung für moderne Klima- und Energielösungen auf. Gesucht werden starke Sales Manager:innen im Raum Berlin/Brandenburg , die Lust haben, von Tag 1 an Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Team etwas Neues aufzubauen. Die Mission Das Verkaufstalent kommt zum Einsatz, um in jedem Gespräch durch Kompetenz und Überzeugungskraft aus vorqualifizierten Interessent:innen erfolgreiche Aufträge zu generieren. Dabei geht es nicht nur um den Verkauf eines Produkts: Die Lösungen verbessern die Lebensqualität von Menschen und machen ihre Energieversorgung zukunftsfähig. Der typische Tag Das Pre-Sales-Team stellt täglich vorqualifizierte Termine bereit. Strukturierte Abschlussgespräche werden eigenständig geführt und Kund:innen kompetent zur passenden Lösung begleitet. Follow-ups und „Baby Calls“ – also Gespräche zum Anwärmen und Aktivieren potenzieller Kund:innen – gehören ebenfalls zum Alltag. Ein modernes CRM-System sorgt für transparente Prozesse, effiziente Arbeitsabläufe und einen jederzeit guten Überblick über die Kund:innen. Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertriebsteam und die aktive Mitgestaltung der entstehenden Prozesse gehören zur Rolle. Das Team arbeitet eng zusammen und entwickelt die neue Abteilung mit viel Dynamik und echtem Start-up-Spirit. Das Profil Gesucht wird eine Person, die: Gespräche gezielt lenken und konzentriert auf einen erfolgreichen Abschlus

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist (Danish Speaking)
jobs.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. What you’ll be doing As a Customer Support Senior Associate you will: Spend your time interacting directly with our customers over chat, email and phone, providing them with an effective, easy and enjoyable Pleo experience. Troubleshoot and resolve customers issues related to the Pleo product, and escalate to the appropriate internal team where needed. Provide feedback and support cross-functional teams on product development based on customer insights. Share learnings and contribute to our knowledge base to ensure growth and knowledge sharing across the team, and beyond. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you: Love providing fantastic, high-touch customer support on live chat, email and phone. Have a persistent and analytical approach to problem-solving. Are able to explain complicated problems in the simplest terms.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Products & Agentic Hospitality (f/m/d)
jobs.description: About the role At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. We're looking for a senior Product Manager to own in our AI product domain. You'll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants. This is not a backlog role. You'll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You'll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue. This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won't receive a roadmap and execute it. You'll shape it along our vision , using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. jobs.title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
jobs.description: Functie Reliability engineer Beschrijving functie De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets. De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden. De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken. Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn. Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf. Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren. Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout Taken Trouble shooting Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen Daily problem solving Continue verbeteren Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
jobs.description: The question Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325–580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix–vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply–accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. jobs.title: M&A Associate (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Über die Rolle Eine gute Kaufentscheidung beginnt damit, dass jemand genau hinsieht. Bei Buena bist du das: Du verstehst das Unternehmen, hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und begründest, welchen Preis wir zahlen sollten. Du verantwortest die Due Diligence für Hausverwaltungen, die wir übernehmen möchten: von der ersten Sichtung des Datenraums über die Bewertung und die Präsentation im Investment Committee bis zu den finanziellen und operativen Anlagen für den Kaufvertrag. Wenn das Committee ins Detail geht, kennst du das Unternehmen und kannst deine Empfehlung fundiert begründen. Unser Prozess steht. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für die Qualität der Analysen übernimmt, die Due Diligence eigenständig steuert und unseren Prozess mit dem Wachstum weiterentwickelt. Über Buena Buena übernimmt Hausverwaltungen und digitalisiert sie mit selbst entwickelter Software. Wir verbinden Akquisitionen, operative Erfahrung und Technologie, um Immobilieneigentum und Verwaltung einfacher zu machen. M&A ist ein zentraler Teil dieser Strategie. Die Unternehmen, die wir kaufen, werden Teil von Buena. Deshalb zählt unser Verständnis ihrer Zahlen, Verträge, Teams und Abläufe weit über den Abschluss einer Transaktion hinaus. Deine Verantwortung Das Unternehmen hinter dem Datenraum verstehen. Du führst Finanzdaten, Verträge, Objektlisten und Mitarbeiterinformationen zusammen. Du erkennst Lücken, gehst Widersprüchen nach und klärst offene Fragen mit den Verkäufern, bis ein belastbares Gesamtbild entsteht. Die Bewertung fundiert herleiten. Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung, arbeitest mit unseren Kaufpreismodellen und prüfst die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen. Du zeigst, was deine Erkenntnisse für den Kaufpreis und die Investitionsentscheidung bedeuten. Deine Ergebnisse im Investment Committee vertreten. Du verdichtest die Due Diligence zu einer klaren Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und offenen Fragen und präsentierst sie direkt vor den Entscheidungsträg

jobs.description: Company Overview Mindpeak is a Hamburg-based AI company on a mission to make cancer diagnosis more accurate, efficient and personalized. We build deep-learning solutions for computational pathology that bring AI directly into clinical practice. Our technology is already used in routine diagnostics across more than 25 countries and supports leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies in developing and advancing new cancer treatments. What makes Mindpeak special is the combination of disciplines required to make this work. Software engineers and machine learning experts work alongside pathologists, scientists, product specialists and commercial teams to turn cutting-edge AI into products that deliver real value in healthcare. This also makes building our team unusually interesting. Many of the people we hire sit at the intersection of different disciplines and are difficult to find through conventional recruiting. Identifying exceptional talent, understanding what great looks like and building hiring processes that allow us to make consistently strong decisions are therefore critical to Mindpeak’s next stage of growth. The Role We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Manager to take ownership of recruiting across Mindpeak. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting and sees Talent Acquisition itself as their profession. You will recruit across different functions, with a particular focus on senior, business-critical and hard-to-fill roles spanning Product, Technology and Business. You will work closely with our founders and hiring managers to define what we actually need, identify what great looks like for each role and translate this into rigorous, efficient hiring processes. jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. jobs.title: Senior Product Owner, Support Platform & AI
jobs.description: About Jimdo We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses. Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world. We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward. At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward. Role Overview At Jimdo, we think the best support is the one a customer never needs. When our customers, self-employed people and small business owners, do need help, it should come fast: from self-service and AI first, and from a person when that's what the case needs. We're bringing our support tooling, Zendesk, chatbots and AI work together into one team with one backlog and one roadmap. As Senior Product Owner, you'll lead that team and own the outcome: more questions answered by AI, faster help, lower cost to serve, and customers who still trust us. You'll also shape where this goes next. Over the next couple of years AI will handle more and more first-line support, and you'll decide how the work is split between AI and people, and build the platform around it. jobs.description: Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results. jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager - Developer Ecosystem
jobs.description: RDQ427R369 At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world s toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world s best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use. We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform. The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers. The impact you will have: Lead and grow the team: Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact. Dit wordt jouw stage Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede Wat ga je doen? Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn. jobs.description: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. SPACE SYSTEMS At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we re building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.  Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions. You will work with a range of customers, including government, defense, civil space, commercial, and prime contractor organizations, with a particular focus on national security and sovereign European space capabilities. Your role will involve identifying and engaging with potential clients, developing strategic partnerships, and leading efforts to secure contracts that expand our market share in this rapidly growing sector. jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer
jobs.description: About Inbolt Deploying an industrial robot still takes months of integration and programming, and the moment a part, a process, or a position changes, it starts over. Inbolt makes it take minutes. Our generalist vision model gives robots the ability to see, think, and adapt in real time, so any robot can master any process, part, or station. Set up from a CAD model in minutes and compatible with FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau, and Universal Robots, Inbolt runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM, Bosch, and more, with 200+ systems live across 100+ factories on three continents. We're a team based in Paris, Detroit, and Japan, and we're growing fast. Here's the role: This position is Paris, France based. Role Overview Your mission is to own the integration of complex robotics features into Inbolt Studio, at 100% industrial-grade quality, from architecture to production on the factory floor. As Senior Robotics Engineer, you are the technical reference for robot control and robot programming in our product. Our roadmap covers static and dynamic robot control whatever the brand. You will architect and build these capabilities, integrate them end to end into Inbolt Studio, and make sure they run reliably on real robots in demanding production environments. You will work at the intersection of robotics, 3D perception, and software engineering, in a small fast growing team where your contribution is visible and your decisions shape the product. This is not an R&D position: your work has a daily impact on what runs in production at Inbolt customers. Want to take your robotics career to the next level by building the future of robot vision guidance in the real world? This role is for you. Responsibilities Feature ownership and architecture Own the design and integration of complex robotics features into Inbolt Studio, from architecture to production release Deliver the roadmap on static and dynamic robot control Make the key technical decisions on motion planning

jobs.description: Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) AI Engineer ! jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, EL2 European Tour
jobs.description: About Electra Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you ve been one of them. At Electra, we re changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We re backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we re moving toward first test flights in 2027. Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another. Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways. The Role Electra seeks an experienced Program Manager to lead the planning and execution of a European tour for Electra s EL2 technology demonstrator aircraft. This role will serve as the primary team lead for the EL2 program, partnering closely with engineering, flight test, government and commercial stakeholders, and company leadership to ensure the tour achieves its strategic objectives safely, on schedule, and within budget. After the completion of the European tour this role will transition to supporting EL9.  The exact nature of this support will depend on the candidates specific skills and interest areas; likely options include test team program management, program office support, or leading teams executing government contract What You ll Do Tour

Krijg jij energie van het doorgronden van complexe productieprocessen en weet je deze te vertalen naar slimme, innovatieve softwareoplossingen? Wil jij de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, richting te geven aan productontwikkeling en écht impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische organisatie? Dan is dit jouw kans! Wat ga je doen? Als Senior Product Manager LogicSteel ben jij dé drijvende kracht achter het doorgronden van productieprocessen en het vertalen daarvan naar slimme oplossingen binnen LogicSteel. LogicSteel is ons cloud-based software platform voor de staalverwerkende industrie. Middels LogicSteel wordt de ontwerpfase, werkvoorbereiding en productie naadloos met elkaar verbonden. Wat kunnen klanten uit LogicSteel halen? Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het automatisch plannen en inkopen van al het materiaal voor productie, het optimaliseren van het proces voor nesting op basis van voorraad en beschikbaarheid, het realtime volgen van het volledige productieproces én het aansturen van onze machines. In deze sleutelrol duik jij in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers. Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk, staat dicht bij de klant en verdiept je in de stappen en randvoorwaarden voor hun productieproces. jobs.title: Senior Visual Designer
jobs.description: At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 countries. How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers. As our Senior Visual Designer, you'll take our visual identity and our website to the next level, and help build a brand that matches our ambitions. Nothing is set in stone, and there's a lot we want to build. This is what you'll do Your work is often the first thing a hotel chain or a bakery sees of us, usually on a screen: our website, a campaign, a landing page. You'll shape how Dyflexis looks and feels everywhere and take the brand from consistent to unmistakable. You'll work closely with our Brand Designer, the Marketing team, and UX/UI colleagues. You bring creative ideas, design thinking and a strong eye for digital. You turn business goals into concepts, carry one strong idea through every touchpoint, and know how to win people over with your work. Take our visual identity further: typography, colour, imagery, illustration and motion, into a bold language that works in every market and language we're in. Bring dyflexis.com to the next level: layouts, landing pages and the visual side of the user journey, together with the Product team. Design campaigns, social, ads, landing pages and sales materials that are on brand and on point. You keep the brand sharp in the everyday work, and you make it better every time. Turn business goals into creative concepts and help shape where the brand goes next

Als senior medewerker Financiële Administratie ben je verantwoordelijk voor een zorgvuldige uitvoering en bewaking van diverse financiële administratieve processen. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in het waarborgen van de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van de financiële administratie. Vanuit jouw financiële expertise ondersteun je de organisatie bij administratieve en financiële vraagstukken. jobs.title: Junior Tester
jobs.description: Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar hoe software werkt en vind je het leuk om uit te zoeken of alles doet wat het zou moeten doen? Heb je oog voor detail, stel je graag kritische vragen en krijg je energie van het vinden van verbeterpunten? Dan is deze functie als Junior Tester precies wat je zoekt! Als tester speel je een belangrijke rol in de kwaliteit van software. Je onderzoekt applicaties, voert testen uit en kijkt kritisch naar de werking ervan. Kom je iets tegen wat niet klopt? Dan analyseer je wat er aan de hand is en zorg je ervoor dat jouw bevindingen duidelijk bij de juiste mensen terechtkomen. Je hoeft nog geen ervaring te hebben als tester. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je leergierig, analytisch en nauwkeurig bent en graag wilt ontdekken hoe je software steeds beter kunt maken. Wat ga je doen als Junior Tester? Als Junior Tester houd je je bezig met het controleren en beoordelen van de werking en kwaliteit van applicaties en systemen. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, analisten en andere betrokken collega's om ervoor te zorgen dat software goed functioneert en voldoet aan de verwachtingen. Je leert stap voor stap hoe je verschillende soorten testen uitvoert en hoe je bevindingen op een duidelijke manier rapporteert. Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden: Opstellen van testscenario's Uitvoeren van testgevallen Controleren of applicaties werken zoals bedoeld Signaleren van fouten, afwijkingen en verbeterpunten Analyseren van testresultaten en bevindingen Registreren en duidelijk communiceren van bevindingen Samenwerken met developers, analisten en andere stakeholders Meedenken over de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van software Leren werken met verschillende testmethodieken en tools Je krijgt gedurende het traineeship de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Zo groei je stap voor stap van trainee naar een zelfstandige tester. Binnen het traineeship Business & IT ontwikkel je jezelf in twee jaar tijd tot een echte IT-prof

jobs.title: Customer Sales Associate, SM Pampanga
jobs.description: We are looking for a Customer Sales Associate to provide attentive, knowledgeable, and personalized customer service. This is position will be reporting to work at SM Pampanga. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Customer Engagement and Service Delivery Welcome and acknowledge customers in a warm, respectful, and professional manner. Observe customer behaviour and offer assistance at an appropriate time without creating unnecessary pressure Understand customer needs through relevant questions and active listening. Assist customers in identifying suitable products based on preferences, occasion, size, and availability. Maintain a helpful and respectful approach throughout the customer journey. Handle routine customer inquiries and refer concerns requiring authorization to the Store Head. Product Knowledge and Merchandise Assistance Maintain working knowledge of current collections, product categories, sizes, styles, features, and available merchandise. Explain product information accurately and avoid unsupported claims. Recommend appropriate complementary products when relevant to customer needs. Assist with product selection, fitting-room requirements, alternative sizes, and styling options. Maintain appropriate customer privacy, comfort, and professional boundaries. Sales Productivity Contribute to the achievements of store sales targets through effective customer assistance. Apply customer engagement techniques that support conversion, ATV, UPT, and other approved KPIs. Participate in daily sales briefings and understand assigned productivity objectives. Respond constructively to coaching and implement agreed improvements. Balance sales productivity with the brand’s non-hard-selling service philosophy. Selling-Floor and Merchandise Standards Maintain cleanliness, orderliness, and presentation of assigned selling areas. Replenish merchandise and maintain correct product placements, size arrangement, and display standards. Ensure

jobs.description: Direct Sales Career Program (DSCP) adalah program pembekalan bagi talenta muda yang ingin tumbuh dengan para professional, khususnya dalam bidang penjualan/sales. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET About Claims AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query. We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against. The team Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Pegawai Pemerintah Non Pegawai Negeri (PPNPN) KPP Pratama
jobs.description: Kantor Pelayanan Pajak atau KPP adalah salah satu unit atau cabang dari Direktorat Jenderal Pajak di Indonesia. Kantor ini bertugas untuk memberikan pelayanan terkait perpajakan kepada wajib pajak yang berada di wilayahnya. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama biasanya melayani wajib pajak yang memiliki jenis usaha atau perorangan dengan volume transaksi yang lebih kecil dibandingkan dengan kantor pajak yang lebih besar seperti Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Besar. Penerimaan Pegawai Pemerintah Non Pegawai Negeri (PPNPN) KPP Pratama. Tugas utama Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama adalah mengumpulkan, mengelola, dan memberikan informasi serta panduan kepada wajib pajak mengenai peraturan perpajakan, pelaporan pajak, serta pembayaran pajak. Mereka juga melakukan pemeriksaan pajak untuk memastikan kepatuhan wajib pajak terhadap aturan perpajakan. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama ini biasanya tersebar di berbagai wilayah di seluruh Indonesia untuk memudahkan wajib pajak dalam mengakses layanan perpajakan tanpa harus pergi ke kantor pajak yang lebih besar. Tujuannya adalah untuk meningkatkan kepatuhan perpajakan dan memfasilitasi wajib pajak dalam memenuhi kewajibannya terkait pajak. Lowongan Kerja Kantor Pelayanan Pajak (KPP) Pratama Saat ini KPP Pratama Majene membuka lowongan kerja untuk posisi Pramubakti untuk mendukung pelaksanaan tugas dan fungsi KPP Pratama. Pegawai Pemerintah Non Pegawai Negeri (PPNPN) KPP Pratama Majene 1. jobs.title: Rekrutmen Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS)
jobs.description: Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS) adalah badan resmi dan satu-satunya yang dibentuk oleh pemerintah berdasarkan Keputusan Presiden RI No. 8 Tahun 2001 yang memiliki tugas dan fungsi menghimpun dan menyalurkan zakat, infak, dan sedekah (ZIS) pada tingkat nasional. Berikut ini lowongan kerja Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS). Lahirnya Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2011 tentang Pengelolaan Zakat semakin mengukuhkan peran BAZNAS sebagai lembaga yang berwenang melakukan pengelolaan zakat secara nasional. Dalam UU tersebut, BAZNAS dinyatakan sebagai lembaga pemerintah nonstruktural yang bersifat mandiri dan bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden melalui Menteri Agama. Dalam mengelola zakat, BAZNAS menerapkan prinsip 3A, yakni Aman Syari, Aman Regulasi, dan Aman NKRI. Aman Syari artinya pengelolaan zakat yang dilaksanakan BAZNAS harus selaras dengan koridor hukum syari. Pengelolaan zakat harus selaras dan tidak boleh bertentangan dengan sumber hukum Islam, Al-Quran dan Sunnah. Aman Regulasi artinya bahwa pengelolaan zakat harus memperhatikan rambu-rambu peraturan hukum dan perundangan. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
